name: August 2024 yen carry trade unwind / global risk-off crash (Aug 4-5 2024)
speed: BTC -30% intraday peak-to-trough over 7 days (Jul 29 -> Aug 5), of which the final ~-15% came in ~36 weekend/overnight hours; ETH -22% in a single 24h window (Aug 4 evening -> Aug 5, worst since May 2021); Nikkei -12.4% in one session; VIX 23 -> 65.73 intraday within hours on Aug 5. Recovery nearly as fast: BTC +8% within hours of the low, >$60k in 3 days.
summary: 4-5 августа 2024: разворот yen carry trade — Nikkei −12.4% (худший день с 1987), VIX 16→65, BTC $70k→$49k (−30% за неделю, −15% за 36 выходных часов), ETH −22% за сутки (продажи Jump), >$1B ликвидаций. Пеги идеальны (USDC min $0.9998), Aave — рекордные ликвидации БЕЗ bad debt (+$6M выручки). Чистый макро-шок без крипто-нативного отказа: контроль «защите нечего делать». Книга SPA на 2026-08: aave_v3 40% / pendle (PT_USDC) 20% / maple 15% / morpho_steakhouse 15% / кэш USDC 10%.

timeline.event: BOJ raises uncollateralized overnight call rate target to ~0.25% (from 0-0.1%) and announces JGB purchase taper; Governor Ueda hawkish in presser. Yen begins sharp appreciation, repricing funding cost of the crowded yen carry trade. (Intraday time approximate; date and 0.25% confirmed.)

Weak US ISM manufacturing print and rising jobless claims spark US growth scare; global equities slide, yen keeps strengthening. (From memory / inferred bridge between BOJ hike and NFP; not independently sourced in this session.)

US July jobs report: nonfarm payrolls +114,000 (vs ~175k expected, vs +215k 12-month average), unemployment rises to 4.3% - Sahm rule recession indicator triggered. Nikkei falls ~5.8% same day (approx.), S&P 500 -1.8% (approx.), VIX intraday high 29.66 (CBOE data, exact). Recession fear becomes the second engine of the unwind.

Weekend: crypto is the only major risk market open; BTC drifts lower on thin liquidity ($60,688 -> $58,306 daily reference rates Aug 3 -> Aug 4, Coin Metrics). Meanwhile Jump Crypto's on-chain unwind of its ETH book continues: ~86,091 ETH unstaked from Lido since Jul 25, ~$377M wstETH liquidated over two weeks (per Arkham/Lookonchain-based reporting; Jump never confirmed the reason).

Sunday evening UTC into Asia Monday open: ETH begins its steep leg from ~$2,700-2,760, ultimately about -22% in ~24h to the $2,100s - its worst single-day fall since May 2021 (reported range across venues/windows: -18% to -26%). BTC breaks down through $58k -> $54k. Several outlets called Sunday Aug 4 'the biggest single-day crypto crash this year'. (Start hour approximate.)

Tokyo Black Monday: Nikkei 225 closes -12.40% at 31,458.42 (-4,451.28 points from 35,909.70), worst single-day fall since October 1987; circuit breakers briefly halt Japanese equity futures trading. USD/JPY hits 141.70 intraday low (close 145.58) - yen up ~8% from pre-BOJ-hike levels. Trading session 00:00-06:00 UTC.

Crypto capitulation during Asian hours: BTC falls below $50,000 for the first time since February 2024, wicking toward ~$49,000 (venue lows reported $49,000-49,221); ETH prints intraday low ~$2,111. Headlines: 'Crypto crash wipes out $1 billion, Bitcoin plunges toward $49,000'. (Exact hour of the wick approximate.)

US pre-market/open panic: VIX spikes to 65.73 intraday - highest since March 2020 - before closing at 38.57 (CBOE daily data, exact). S&P 500 closes -3.0% (worst day in ~2 years), Nasdaq -3.4%, Dow -2.6%.

Damage tally for the 24h: crypto futures liquidations top $1B (CoinDesk initially reported $840M, updated to >$1B; Decrypt/Cointelegraph '>$1 billion'; majority longs, per CoinGlass). On-chain: Aave has a record liquidation day, processing liquidations cleanly and earning ~$6M revenue with no bad-debt event; The Defiant: 'all-time Aave v3 liquidations double'. Ethereum total daily fees spike ~8x to 6,603 ETH vs ~800 ETH/day prior week (Coin Metrics). USDC/USDT/DAI hold peg throughout (daily refs within +/-0.3%). No withdrawal freezes, no oracle failures, no protocol insolvency.
First bounce: BTC recovers to ~$53k by late Aug 5 ('Bitcoin Bounces to $53K After Brutal Sell-Off Reminiscent of Covid Crash' - CoinDesk).
Nikkei rebounds ~+10% (largest point gain on record, approx.); BTC jumps above $56k, broad crypto recovery ('Bitcoin Jumps Above $56K, Solana Leads Recovery From Monday's Rout').

BOJ Deputy Governor Uchida walks back hawkishness: BOJ will not raise rates while markets are unstable - relief rally in yen crosses and risk assets ('First Mover Americas: BoJ Comments Offer Relief to Crypto'). Jump Trading still selling: another ~$29M ETH moved, ~$63M estimated left (Cointelegraph, Aug 7).
BTC back above $60k (Coin Metrics daily reference rate $61,909 on Aug 8 - 3 days after the trough), aided by strong US jobless claims data. Acute phase over; ETH lags at ~$2,687.

defi_impact.bad_debt_notes: No material new bad debt reported on Aave v3, Morpho, Maple, Compound or other major money markets - liquidations cleared profitably despite -22% ETH in 24h. This is the key negative result: the DeFi credit layer passed a violent macro stress test.
defi_impact.gas: Ethereum total daily fees spiked ~8x: 6,602.9 ETH burned/paid on Aug 5 vs ~430-1,350 ETH/day in the prior 8 days (Coin Metrics FeeTotNtv, exact). Rebalancing/liquidation transactions cost several times normal exactly during the cascade.
defi_impact.oracle_behavior: No oracle failures or material staleness reported; Chainlink feeds updated at high frequency through the move (inference from absence of incident reports - no positive verification).
defi_impact.withdrawal_freezes: None on major DeFi protocols. Money-market utilization and borrow APYs spiked intraday as liquidators borrowed stables (inference), but no gating events reported.
defi_impact.protocols_paused_or_insolvent: None. No crypto-native failure: no depeg, no protocol insolvency, no bridge hack, no CEX failure.
defi_impact.chains_bridges: No major chain outage reported (Solana, L2s stayed up); Japanese equity futures - not crypto rails - were what hit circuit breakers.

causes.primary: Pure macro shock: BOJ's Jul 31 rate hike to ~0.25% + hawkish guidance collided with an abrupt US growth scare (weak ISM Aug 1, +114k NFP / 4.3% unemployment Aug 2 triggering the Sahm rule), forcing a violent unwind of massively crowded yen-funded carry trades and cross-asset deleveraging. No crypto-native failure occurred.
secondary: Crowded leveraged positioning: yen shorts near record (CFTC) and levered long-tech/long-risk books funded in yen; volatility spike mechanically tightened margin constraints (BIS Bulletin 90 framing)
Weekend timing: crypto was the only major market open Aug 3-4, so it became the pressure-release valve, with thin Sunday-night liquidity amplifying the move

Jump Crypto's on-chain liquidation of its ETH book (~$377M wstETH over two weeks, ~$481-500M total per on-chain trackers; reason never officially confirmed - CFTC scrutiny and president's June departure were the backdrop) deepened ETH's underperformance vs BTC
Rumor amplification: unverified chatter about Paradigm-style OTC sales and Golem's ETH exchange transfers circulated on Aug 5; only Jump's flows were credibly traced on-chain
Background ETH supply pressure: Grayscale ETHE outflows (~$2B since ETF debut) and Genesis bankruptcy distributions (~$4B incl. ~$3B crypto) in the same week
Geopolitical jitters (feared Iran-Israel escalation) cited as an additional risk-off overlay
causes.mechanism: BOJ hike + hawkish signal -> yen appreciates -> carry-trade funding costs and FX losses trigger margin calls -> weak US data adds recession fear -> levered cross-asset books de-gross -> Japanese equities crash (-12.4% Aug 5) and VIX spikes to 65.73 -> correlated selling of anything liquid, with crypto sold first over the weekend (only open market, thin liquidity) -> perp funding flips, >$1B futures liquidation cascade -> spot wicks (BTC ~$49k, ETH ~$2.1k) -> on-chain collateral liquidations (record Aave day) processed cleanly at 8x gas -> BOJ verbally capitulates Aug 7 -> V-shaped partial recovery.

contagion: Jul 31: BOJ hikes to 0.25% -> yen surges, carry-trade funding reprices
Aug 1-2: weak US ISM + NFP 114k/4.3% unemployment (Sahm rule) -> recession fear joins the unwind
Aug 2: Nikkei -5.8%, US equities slide, VIX to ~29 -> margin calls on yen-funded levered books
Aug 3-4 (weekend): crypto only market open; thin Sunday liquidity -> BTC/ETH sold as liquid risk proxy
Aug 4-5: Jump Crypto wstETH/ETH sales + rumors amplify ETH leg (-22% in 24h, worst since May 2021)
Aug 5 Asia: Nikkei -12.4% (worst since 1987), circuit breakers; USD/JPY 141.7 -> full risk-off
Aug 5: >$1B crypto futures liquidations in 24h (majority longs) -> spot wicks BTC ~$49k / ETH ~$2,111
Aug 5 on-chain: record Aave liquidation day ($6M revenue, no bad debt), ETH fees spike ~8x; stablecoins hold peg - contagion STOPS at the DeFi solvency layer
Aug 5 US: VIX 65.73 intraday, S&P -3.0% -> but no funding/credit event in TradFi either
Aug 6-8: Nikkei +10%, BOJ Uchida dovish walk-back (Aug 7) -> BTC back >$60k by Aug 8; ETH recovery lags

recovery.time_to_recover: BTC: +8% within hours of the wick (back to $53k late Aug 5), >$56k Aug 6, >$60k by Aug 8 (3 days after trough); full recovery to the ~$70k pre-event level only in late Oct 2024 (approx, from memory). ETH: much slower - still ~$2,687 on Aug 8, and did not durably reclaim its pre-crash ~$3,200 level until Nov 2024 (approx, from memory). Nikkei: +10% Aug 6 (approx), pre-crash level regained within ~5-6 weeks (approx).
recovery.notes: Classic V-shaped macro-shock recovery once the policy trigger reversed (BOJ Uchida's Aug 7 'no hikes while markets unstable'). Because nothing broke in crypto's plumbing, prices mean-reverted quickly; ETH lagged due to the Jump inventory overhang and ETHE outflows. DeFi yields: a one-day liquidation windfall for lenders followed by softer borrowing demand as leverage reset.

spa_relevance.summary: This is the canonical 'violent macro crash with zero crypto-native failure' scenario for a $100k USDC yield portfolio: NAV in stable-denominated lending barely moves, pegs hold, nothing freezes - yet the operating environment (gas, utilization, exit liquidity, APY path) whipsaws violently for ~72 hours.
spa_relevance.aave_v3_usdc: HIT CHANNEL: none to solvency; actually a windfall day - record liquidations processed cleanly, ~$6M protocol revenue, USDC supply APY spiked with utilization as liquidators/shorts borrowed stables, then normalized. Residual risks that WERE live: (a) intraday utilization spike can temporarily make a full large withdrawal impossible until rates draw repayments; (b) had ETH fallen another ~15-20% with 8x gas, liquidation lag could have created bad debt socialized to suppliers.
spa_relevance.pendle_pt: HIT CHANNEL: mark-to-market + exit liquidity, not credit. PT held to maturity was unaffected, but implied yields spiked and AMM liquidity thinned exactly when a stress-driven rebalance would want to exit - a mid-crisis PT sale would have realized a haircut (magnitude unverified). Unpriced if the system marks PT at par-trajectory and assumes exit at quoted price.
spa_relevance.maple: HIT CHANNEL: none observed in Aug 2024 - no defaults or delinquencies reported in cash-management/secured lending pools. Latent risk is the same as any fixed-term credit position: capital is locked regardless of macro stress, so it contributes nothing to crisis-time liquidity.
spa_relevance.morpho_steakhouse_usdc: HIT CHANNEL: same as Aave - collateral (wstETH etc.) down >20% in 24h tested liquidation engines; no bad debt reported. Vault-specific risk: curator concentration in LST-collateral markets during an event where stETH traded at a small intraday discount (discount unverified) - an oracle using the stETH market price vs the ETH-per-share rate would have behaved differently.
spa_relevance.cash_10pct: Performed exactly as designed - the only sleeve that could pay 8x gas and buy the dip / meet obligations without touching thinned exit liquidity.
unpriced_if_usdc_equals_1_and_always_wit: Gas-cost shock: rebalancing cost ~8x normal exactly when triggers fire (Coin Metrics FeeTotNtv, verified) - a fixed gas budget assumption breaks
Utilization-spike withdrawal friction on money markets during the cascade (hours-scale, not a freeze - but binding for same-block full exits)
PT exit-liquidity haircut / implied-yield spike for any pre-maturity unwind
APY whipsaw: one-day supply-APY spike followed by weeks of compressed yields as leverage reset - a yield-chasing rebalancer would buy the spike and hold the compression
LST secondary-market discount as a hidden oracle/collateral channel in Morpho/Aave LST markets

False kill-switch positives: BTC -30%/ETH -22% headlines with portfolio NAV flat - a drawdown ladder keyed to market beta rather than evidenced portfolio NAV would have de-risked into a V-bottom for nothing. This event is the regression test that SOFT/HARD triggers must key off portfolio drawdown, not market drawdown.
spa_relevance.kill_switch_note: Portfolio-level evidenced drawdown for this composition through Aug 4-8 2024 would have been well under the 5% SOFT tier (stables held peg, no bad debt, no freeze) - correct behavior is HOLD + log, not de-risk.

assumptions: PT-дисконт 2.5% (WARN, без выхода) — implied-yield спайк риск-оффа; остальное — операционный шторм без потерь капитала.
